What's your favourite tomato sauce recipe?

Mine has to be the most basic here, but damn it tastes so good with everything. I'm sure if you add some stock and water to it and purée it, it could make some damn amazing tomato soup.

Ingredient list:

  • 1 can of chopped tomatoes
  • 1 half onion
  • 1 clove garlic
  • About 4 button mushrooms
  • Extra Virgin Olive Oil
  • 1 half zucchini
  • 2 fresh tomatoes
  • Seasoning of choice

Method:

  1. Heat oil in a pan. Chop up the onion and zuchinni, as well as the mushrooms and tomatoes.
  2. Add your chopped vegetables, stir on high heat until softened. Then stir in your can of tomatoes.
  3. Add a splash of olive oil and add seasoning. I usually add some red pepper seasoning, citrus pepper, garlic salt and dried coriander.
  4. Serve over meal of choice, typically pasta. Finely chop your clove of garlic over the sauce and tuck in.

Super simple, cheap and takes very little time to make. One of my favourite go to recipes for tomato sauce!
